claims.statement: #Sha(E/Q)[3^infinity] <= 9; hence, with S.3L, Sha(E/Q)[3^infinity] is isomorphic to (Z/3)^2, with no Skinner, Skinner-Urban or GRH input. At the nonsplit multiplicative prime 3, T = T_3E is an extension of Z_3(eta) by T^0 = Z_3(1)(x)eta, with eta the unramified quadratic character (a_3 = -1). The eta-twist of Kobayashi's Coleman map for the Tate curve is an integral Coleman map H^1_Iw(Q_3,T)/H^1_Iw(Q_3,T^0) -> Lambda; it is an isomorphism and sends Kato's zeta element to the 3-adic L-function L_3 (alpha = -1, Neron differential).
